title: Build a Topic Intake Agent
prompt: Transfer what you learned: create topic_agent(topic). It must remove spaces around the topic and return READY: followed by the cleaned topic. Example: topic_agent("  AI safety  ") returns "READY: AI safety".
starterCode: # Build a new agent function — this is different from the trainer example.
testCode:
assert topic_agent("  AI safety  ") == "READY: AI safety"
assert topic_agent("Robotics") == "READY: Robotics"

title: Repair the Quality Gate
prompt: Fix quality_gate so scores of 7 or more return APPROVED and lower scores return REVISE. Both hidden cases must pass.
testCode:
assert quality_gate(7) == "APPROVED"
assert quality_gate(6) == "REVISE"
assert quality_gate(10) == "APPROVED"

title: Create a Handoff Summary
prompt: Create handoff_summary(agent, result) that returns a dictionary with the exact keys agent, result, and ready. ready must be True.
starterCode: # Package an agent result for the next specialist.
testCode:
assert handoff_summary("researcher", "3 facts") == {"agent": "researcher", "result": "3 facts", "ready": True}
assert handoff_summary("reviewer", "approved")["ready"] is True
